description: Land Acquisition - Arukwatta & Angampitiya Villages, Padukka D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, providing detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for public purpose. It contains no government personnel changes, structural changes, or any elements that would fall under Types 1-3. The content focuses entirely on land matters - property descriptions, boundaries, ownership details, and acquisition procedures - which clearly fits the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) for land and property-related administrative matters.
